text:
Chloe Park: Ok team — Helios (customer: Petaluma Labs) private deployment confirmed for Thu 2024-04-18 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need owners for deploy, smoke, and rollback readiness.
AJ Patel: I'll own the deploy + live smoke. Prep checklist?
Chloe Park: thanks AJ. Smoke steps below. Marcus you on rollback?
Marcus Li: Yup. I'll stage rollback on standby and validate DB backups. Ping me 10m before cutover.
Samir Gupta: Heads up: the local auth migration requires a short downtime; added migration flag --no-async. Need confirm from infra that network ACLs are open to on-prem mgmt host.
Lina Torres: I've updated the runbook: /runbooks/petaluma-cutover.md (internal). Added section 'post-cutover sanity'.
ops-bot: Calendar: Helios private cutover scheduled Thu 2024-04-18 02:00 UTC. Attendees: chloe, aj, marcus, samir, lina. Reminder 30m before.
AJ Patel: Smoke checklist:
```
- curl -sS https://petaluma.internal/health | jq .status == "ok"
- run smoke script: ./scripts/smoke.sh --target petaluma
- confirm KV cache warmed: /admin/cache-status
```
Chloe Park: Rollback procedure (short):
- trigger: /ops rollback petaluma --to-tag v1.9.2
- verify rollback logs: gcloud logging read 'resource:petaluma AND severity>=ERROR' --limit 50
Marcus Li: I'll keep the rollback command alias ready. Also will run quick checksum on storage snapshot after migration.
Samir Gupta: Infra confirms ACLs set. One small ask: add a temporary metric alert on 5m error rate > 2% for the route /api/v1/auth
Lina Torres: done — added alert: petaluma.auth.5m_err > 2% -> team-oncall channel.
AJ Patel: lgtm. I'll post 'deploying' 5m before and 'live' once smoke passes. :thumbsup:
Chloe Park: Thanks all. If nobody objects, marking this window locked. Leave any final notes here.
Marcus Li: No objections. I'll be on-call during the window.
Samir Gupta: All good from infra.
Lina Torres: No blockers.
Chloe Park: Locked. See you Thu.
